방송 중 채팅이 급증하면 OBS 리플레이 버퍼를 저장하고 해당 장면을 클:
When the chat surges during a stream, OBS's replay buffer is saved and the moment is cut out as a clip.
Set the maximum replay time in OBS to 60 seconds or more.
The higher it is, the smaller a surge is enough to save a clip.
Enter the address of a live YouTube stream.
